newsitem.title: USA: Dow Chemical sees higher Q4 comparisons.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical sees higher Q4 comparisons.

text.p: Dow Chemical Co said on Thursday that higher U.S. feedstock costs will continue to dampen results somewhat, but the company expects to see higher comparisons for the fourth quarter versus last year.
"The global economic outlook remains positive. Our September sales were particularly strong, creating good momentum for the fourth quarter," said chief financial officer Pedro Reinhard.

"While higher feedstock costs in the U.S. will continue to dampen results somewhat, we expect to see higher comparisons for the fourth quarter versus last year. Our strategy is on track and 1996 should be another good year for Dow," Reinhard said.

In the fourth quarter of 1995, Dow earned $415 million, or $1.63 a share, on revenues of $4.59 billion. For the full 1995 year, Dow earned $2.07 billion, or $7.72 a share, on revenues of $20.2 billion.
Dow earlier reported net income of $469 million, or $1.92 a share, for the third quarter, down from $571 million, or $2.15 a share in the year-ago period.
